bounded_intake: Two genuinely new primary candidates, not a systematic review; stopped once the useful 200-number OCT source resolved.

candidates.actual_numeric_source: chx_source.xlsx; one OCT data worksheet; 200 numbers plus four group headers; raw hash in manifest
candidates.substrate_and_scope: Established composite/adhesive restoration on coronal dentin of extracted human teeth; not mineral regrowth
candidates.depth: Nominal 2 mm deep, 4 mm wide cavities; no per-specimen actual repair depth
candidates.challenge: After 10,000 thermal cycles; not mechanical fatigue; no pre-aging measurements
candidates.interface_endpoint: Percentage of selected cavity-floor width with enhanced binary OCT signal after silver processing; no depth-normalized leakage flux
candidates.hierarchy: Primary reports five teeth per group and ten serial scans per tooth. Worksheet contains five separated blocks of ten values per group. Block-mean SD reproduces four published SDs; tooth and donor IDs remain unknown.
candidates.linkage: OCT result and thermal challenge apply to the source cavity assay, but actual depth, individual IDs and tensile/failure-history crosswalk are missing.
candidates.eligibility: PARTIAL ONLY: concrete post-challenge interface benchmark with conditional hierarchy audit
adverse_or_unknown: Higher SE/CHX mean OCT signal than SE
Seven-value repeated run in ER source blocks 2 and 5 retained
Unlinked SE/CHX tensile summary is lower than SE, with 9 of 10 adhesive failures
Unreported losses not set to zero

candidates.source_status: Primary XML and public repository HTML retrieved. Normal public page rendered no file links; bounded public API attempts returned HTTP 404, an empty listing or application error 400. No workbook downloaded. This does not establish dataset absence.
candidates.relevant_endpoints: Source describes resin-dentin strength and failure modes immediately and after six/eighteen months of wet storage, with sticks split from the same teeth. Actual stick/tooth/depth crosswalk could not be inspected.
candidates.rights: Repository CC BY 4.0; Data in Brief article metadata CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. No images or adapted figures published.
candidates.eligibility: NOT EXECUTABLE FROM RETRIEVED RAW DATA; no further attempts or contacts this batch

continuity: Shao 2019, Hasan 2025, HEA 2024 and prior Theisen material comparisons were not reanalyzed. Native enamel/dentin/pulp/PDL/gum/position after finite support remain required.
